prompt.text:
Implement a deterministic widget-layout module. Export `CanvasSize`, `Widget`, `WidgetCommand`, and `applyWidgetCommand`. `CanvasSize` has numeric `width` and `height`. `Widget` has `id`, `x`, `y`, `width`, `height`, and `selected`. Commands are `{ type: "move"; x: number; y: number }`, `{ type: "resize"; width: number; height: number }`, or `{ type: "select"; selected: boolean }`. `applyWidgetCommand(widget, command, canvas)` must return a new widget and never mutate or alias the input. Canvas dimensions and all command coordinates or dimensions must be finite. Canvas dimensions must be positive; otherwise throw `RangeError`. Move coordinates are clamped so the entire widget remains inside the canvas. Resize dimensions are clamped between 20 and the canvas dimensions, and the position is then clamped to keep the resized widget inside. Selection changes only `selected`. Empty identifiers are allowed and preserved. Existing widget dimensions must be finite and positive; malformed widgets throw `RangeError`. Values exactly on a boundary are accepted.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
